sasha: Heads up — intermittent ingress mTLS handshakes failing in eu-west this morning, seeing a bunch of 502s. Problem looks correlated with keystore unwrap errors. Anyone oncall?
kevin: saw it. spike around 03:14-03:18 UTC. KMS calls returning `AccessDenied` for role `service-keystore-role-eu`.
marta: I pushed a policy scoping tweak to `service-keystore-role-eu` last night (PR #3421). Could be that.
kevin: logs snippet I grabbed: ```2026-03-21T03:15:02Z ingress-proxy[pid=123] WARN keystore.unwrap failed: KMSDecryptAccessDenied role=service-keystore-role-eu request_id=abc123```
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — keystore.unwrap error rate > 5% in eu-west-1 for the last 10m. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-unwrap
sam: I'm on it, rolling back Marta's RBAC change to see if that clears it. @marta can you confirm revert?
marta: reverted the scoping change and re-applied the previous policy (PR revert merged -> deploy started). Also added `kms:Decrypt` explicitly for the keystore proxy principal as a stopgap.
kevin: after revert handshake success jumped back to ~99.8% within 3 minutes. Still seeing a small tail of certificate validation failures (cache evictions).
sasha: could be rotator/propagation timing — did the cert rotator rotate intermediates recently? I remember a rotator run at 02:58 UTC.
marta: rotator logs show a couple warnings during that window: ```2026-03-21T02:58:10Z cert-rotator INFO rotating cert service=ingress-eu; fetched intermediate: nil -> scheduling chain refresh``` might indicate transient missing intermediate chain on some hosts.
sam: temporarily pinned fallback CA on canary hosts and forced chain refresh. canary shows normal handshakes now. We'll expand if green for 15m.
kevin: quick action items: 1) add alert rule for KMSDecryptDenied to fire before the 5% threshold, 2) add preflight check to cert rotator that verifies full chain availability before swapping, 3) add an integration test to prevent overly-narrow RBAC changes from merging.
sasha: :thumbsup: I'll file the tickets and link to this thread.
eng-sre-bot: Deploy finished: ingress-eu-west rollback canary applied to 2 hosts (eu-west-1a).
marta: QA note — when we do TLS hardening we should be careful: I propose TLS 1.3 default, allow TLS 1.2 for legacy clients for 30 days, and explicitly test cipher suites.
sam: agree. I'll prepare a terraform patch to tighten `tls_min_version = "1.2"` + a restricted cipher list and include a phased rollout.
kevin: tagging incident sev2 for tracking. No data leaked; root cause = RBAC policy scoping change + timing with cert rotation. Follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-21-keystore-decrypt-jitter (I'll draft).
sasha: Great. Thanks all for fast turnaround. We'll close after postmortem and the rotator preflight is in. :eyes:
